name: io.github.paeyoungpark-web/lupa-mcp
description: Search this Mac's files by name and by what is written inside documents (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Hangul HWP/HWPX, scanned PDFs via OCR). Reads Lupa's local index — no network, ~100ms, Korean-aware. Requires the free Lupa app from the Mac App Store.
title: Lupa — local file search for your Mac
